summary.name: CotEditor
summary.one_liner: CotEditor is a free, open-source plain-text editor built for macOS.
use_cases: editing source code and markup on a Mac
find and replace with regular expressions
recovering unsaved text after a crash
checking characters that will not survive encoding conversion
writing and editing CJK text including vertical text
automating text edits with scripts or macros
summary.what_it_does: CotEditor is a plain-text editor for macOS. It provides syntax highlighting for more than 60 pre-installed languages, including HTML, PHP, Python, Ruby and Markdown, and users can define their own syntax settings. Find and replace uses the ICU regular expression engine. Settings, syntax definitions and themes are managed through a standard settings window rather than configuration files. It also automatically backs up documents while editing, lists characters that cannot be converted to a chosen encoding, and offers a Unicode character inspector, a split editor, and an outline menu for jumping to lines defined by syntax.
notable: Open source, developed publicly on GitHub and open to contributions
Macros/scripting in Python, Ruby, Perl, PHP, UNIX shell, AppleScript or JavaScript
Accurate file encoding estimation and vertical text mode for CJK languages
Automatic backup of unsaved document data
caveats: Only available for macOS; no other platforms are named on the page
